ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can run tens of thousands of aerodynamic iterations overnight, but the chief engineer's judgment about why a design should work still depends on physical intuition.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 71,600 aerospace engineers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 75,900 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 4,300 jobs and roughly 4,500 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $134,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace aerospace engineers, but it will take over the most expensive trial-and-error work. AI can iterate at scale on aerodynamic shape optimization, structural topology optimization, and simulation parameter searches. Engineers shift from calculating everything themselves to setting boundaries, interpreting results, and approving designs. People remain firmly responsible for safety and airworthiness certification, where lives and major costs are at stake.
ai_s2_accel: AI surrogate models replace some expensive CFD simulations
Digital twins connect design, testing, and operations across the lifecycle
AI-assisted organization of airworthiness documents and compliance verification
Generative design expands opportunities for innovative lightweight structures
ai_s2_auto: Automated parametric optimization and repeated iteration of aerodynamic shapes
Structural topology optimization and lightweight design searches
Simulation mesh generation and batch job scheduling
Assistance with code generation and document drafts
ai_s3_list: Overall design decisions: make tradeoffs among weight, performance, cost, and safety.
On-site test judgment: determine whether abnormal data reflects a system issue or a test issue.
Systems engineering: integrate aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, and controls into a system that can fly.
Airworthiness and safety responsibility: systematically eliminate every foreseeable failure point.
Cross-functional coordination: align requirements with manufacturing, testing, customers, and regulators.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means AI is taking over much of the calculation, while engineers still define solutions, accept responsibility, and run tests. More computation-focused roles, such as pure optimization, will become tool-driven faster, while chief-engineer decisions become more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean low challenge. Engineers who use AI surrogate models and digital twins can reduce design cycles from months to weeks, a core advantage in fast-moving commercial space. People who follow old processes and avoid new tools will fall behind.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Strong mathematics and physics are essential, with aerospace, mechanics, and controls as preferred majors. Build a foundation in quantitative methods and programming during college and join laboratory projects early. Families should understand that many roles carry security and location restrictions.

Master AI simulation, digital twins, and surrogate models. These are today's most valuable incremental skills. Participate across the full program lifecycle, progress from working on parts to understanding systems, and aim for technical leadership.

People with mechanics, mechanical engineering, or automation backgrounds can move into aerospace structures, controls, or manufacturing. Software specialists can enter simulation, data, or digital airworthiness. Emphasize engineering problems you solved, not a list of tool names.

Commercial space companies compete intensely for talent. Retain people with a mix of program involvement, technical growth, and equity or project incentives. Engineers who are strong in AI simulation and can shorten iteration cycles command a premium.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Flow-field calculation and aerodynamic performance evaluation
Strength checks and lightweight design validation
Connect data across design, testing, and operations
Automatically generate new structures through topology optimization
Queue and schedule simulation cases in batches
Generate simulation scripts and post-processing code

ai_s7_trends: AI surrogate models and digital twins become standard design tools, sharply shortening program iteration cycles.
Commercial space, advanced air mobility, and satellite internet expand, with private companies creating much of the new hiring.
Electric aircraft and eVTOL create new propulsion and airworthiness needs, raising the premium for multidisciplinary talent.

body: Aerospace engineers design aircraft, helicopters, missiles, satellites, and launch vehicles, covering overall design, aerodynamics, structural strength, propulsion, navigation, guidance and control, and test validation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在一夜之间跑完几万次气动迭代，但「为什么这么设计」这层总师级的判断，得靠工程师脑子里那套物理直觉。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年航空航天工程师在岗约 7.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.59 万人，净增约 0.43 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.45 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代航空航天工程师，但会接管最烧钱的「试错」环节：气动外形优化、结构拓扑优化、仿真参数搜索都能交给 AI 大规模迭代。工程师的角色从「亲手算」变成「定边界、看结果、拍板方案」。安全性和适航认证这些关乎人命与成本的环节，依然牢牢在人手里。
ai_s2_accel: AI 代理模型替代部分高成本 CFD 仿真
数字孪生技术贯穿设计-试验-运维全流程
AI 辅助适航文件梳理与符合性验证
生成式设计拓展轻量化结构创新空间
ai_s2_auto: 气动外形参数化优化与多轮迭代自动化
结构拓扑优化与轻量化方案搜索
仿真网格生成与算例批量调度
代码生成与文档草稿辅助编写
ai_s3_list: 总体设计决策：在重量、性能、成本、安全之间拍板。
试验现场判断：数据异常时判断是系统问题还是测试问题。
系统工程思维：把气动、结构、动力、控制捏成一个能飞的系统。
适航与安全责任：把「可能出错」的环节逐个堵死。
跨团队协调：跟制造、试验、客户、监管把需求对齐。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行「算」的部分正被 AI 大规模接管，但「定方案、担责任、跑试验」的核心依然靠工程师；评分高一点的方向（如纯优化计算岗）会更快被工具化，而总师级决策反而更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于低挑战：会用 AI 做代理模型、数字孪生的工程师，能把设计周期从按月缩到按周，在商业航天拼速度的时代就是核心竞争力。只会跑老流程、不碰新工具的人会被甩开。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数学物理基础是底线，航空航天、力学、控制专业优先。本科打好数理和编程底子，尽早进实验室跟项目；家里要理解这行很多岗位有保密与地域限制。
把 AI 仿真、数字孪生、代理模型玩熟，这是现在最值钱的技术增量。多参与型号全流程，从「做零件」向「懂系统」靠拢，向专业带头人方向走。
力学、机械、自动化背景可转航天结构、控制、制造方向；纯软件背景可以切仿真、数据、适航数字化。简历上突出你解决过的工程问题，别只堆工具名。
商业航天抢人很凶，用「型号参与度 + 技术成长 + 股权/项目激励」组合留人。AI 仿真能力强、能缩短迭代周期的工程师值得溢价。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 流场计算与气动性能评估
强度校核与轻量化验证
替代部分高成本仿真算例
设计-试验-运维数据贯通
拓扑优化自动生成新结构
仿真脚本与后处理代码生成

ai_s7_trends: AI 代理模型与数字孪生成为设计标配，型号迭代周期大幅缩短。
商业航天、低空经济与卫星互联网扩张，民营公司成为主要增量岗位来源。
电动飞机与 eVTOL 带动新型动力与适航需求，复合型人才溢价明显。

body: 航空航天工程师负责飞行器（飞机、直升机、导弹、卫星、运载火箭）的总体设计、气动分析、结构强度、动力系统、导航制导与控制、以及试验验证。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assist with contract drafting and data-driven casting, but agents remain responsible for negotiation, trust, and access to opportunities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 21,400 agents and business managers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 23,200 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 1,800 jobs and about 2,200 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $96,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agents, but it will assist with contract drafting and data-driven casting. Models can screen business matches and draft terms, shifting agents from finding opportunities toward negotiating major deals and protecting clients. Pure intermediaries face pressure, while skilled negotiators with strong networks become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Negotiation and client protection: people provide judgment.
Access to opportunities: people provide relationships.
Trust-based business: people sustain relationships.
Crisis management: people exercise judgment.
Image management: people understand nuance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Tools accelerate work, but human trust and negotiation remain difficult to replace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean zero risk. Pure intermediaries are vulnerable, not well-connected agents who create access. People with strong networks and negotiation skills become scarcer as technology improves. Those who only relay messages face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in media or business and intern at a talent agency early to develop relationships.
Progress from execution support to managing clients independently, building both resources and a record of results.
Emphasize negotiation and access. Clearly identify the talent and engagements you supported.
Hire for networks and access. People who can protect clients deserve a share of revenue.

ai_s7_trends: Data-driven casting becomes common.
AI assists with contract drafting.
Well-connected agents become scarcer.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 合约起草与数据选角能被辅助，但谈判信任与资源运作，还是经纪扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年经理商业在岗约 2.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.32 万人，净增约 0.18 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代经纪人，但会辅助合约起草与数据选角。模型筛商务匹配、拟条款，经纪从「找机会」转向「谈大单、护客户」。真正被挤掉的是纯中介，有资源会谈判的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 谈判护客：脑子靠人。
资源运作：门路靠人。
信任经营：关系靠人。
危机处理：判断靠人。
形象拿捏：分寸靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的关系区——工具提速，但人的信任与谈判难被替。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零风险：被替代的是「纯中介」，不是「资源型经纪」的岗位。有门路、会谈判的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会传话的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 传媒商科打底，早点进经纪公司实习攒人脉。
从执行升级成独立带客，攒资源与案例。
突出谈判与资源，写清跟过哪些 talent。
选人看资源与人脉，能护客的值得给分成。

ai_s7_trends: 数据选角普及。
合约辅助起草。
资源型经纪更缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate images and administer scales, but an art therapist still helps people reveal emotions through creation and understand the pain beyond the artwork.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 56,100 therapists in this category were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 62,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,400 jobs, with roughly 4,100 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $65,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace art therapists, but it will support peripheral tasks. Digital assessments, artwork archiving, and scheduling are becoming faster, shifting therapists from handwritten records toward understanding people and designing interventions. Pure documentation and preliminary screening face the greatest pressure, while strong therapeutic ability becomes more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Empathic support: people must receive the emotion.
Creative guidance: people must guide breakthroughs.
Case conceptualization: people must set the direction.
Crisis stabilization: people must protect safety.
Therapeutic relationships: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure zone. Core therapeutic interaction remains human, while documentation and preliminary screening are accelerated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Documentation and preliminary screening tasks are being automated, not face-to-face therapy. Therapists with empathy who can design interventions become scarcer as productivity improves. Those limited to mechanical recordkeeping face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in psychology or art, and learn about master's degree and registration requirements early. Pure documentation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop therapeutic ability.
Move beyond recordkeeping to intervention design and interdisciplinary collaboration. Learn assessment and crisis response.
Highlight your training and supervised cases, and specify the populations you served. Institutions value steadiness and strong professional boundaries.
Do not assess candidates solely by their creative work. Evaluate empathy and case conceptualization. Core staff who can lead groups and handle crises are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Mental health needs drive job demand
School and community settings expand
Digital assistance improves productivity and retention

body: Art Therapists use art-making as a therapeutic medium. Through assessment and case formulation, they help clients address emotions, trauma, and developmental issues as expressive therapy professionals within mental health services.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate images and administer scales, but an art therapist still helps people reveal emotions through creation and understand the pain beyond the artwork.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成图、做量表，但陪人在创作里把情绪摊开、读懂画外的痛，还是治疗师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年治疗师在岗约 5.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.25 万人，净增约 0.64 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.50 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代艺术治疗师，但会辅助外围。数字测评、作品归档与排程被提速，治疗师从「手写记录」挪向「读人 + 设计干预」。真正被挤掉的是纯记录与初筛，有治疗力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 共情接住：情绪靠人接。
创作引导：突破靠人带。
个案概念化：方向靠人定。
危机稳场：安全靠人守。
治疗关系：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在低中 AI 曝光区——核心治疗互动还留着人的位置，被加速的只是记录与初筛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「写记录、做初筛」动作，不是「面对面治疗」的岗位。有共情力、能设计干预的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做机械记录的治疗师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 心理或艺术本科打底，早点了解硕士与注册要求，AI 时代纯记录在缩，练治疗力。
从「做记录」升级成「设计干预 + 跨团队协作」，学评估与危机处理。
突出受训与实习个案，写清服务过哪些人群。机构看重稳与边界。
选人别只看创作，要看共情与个案概念化。能带团体、做危机处理的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 心理健康需求拉动岗位
学校与社区场景扩展
数字辅助提效留人

body: 艺术治疗师以艺术创作为治疗媒介，在评估与个案概念化基础上，帮助来访者处理情绪、创伤与发展性议题，是心理健康服务中的表达性治疗专业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能生成图、做量表，但陪人在创作里把情绪摊开、读懂画外的痛，还是治疗师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can cut a match into ten tactical clips, but a coach still has to understand why a player lost confidence and bring that player back in the locker room.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Coaches And Scouts is projected to rise from about 306,500 in 2024 to 326,000 in 2034, a net increase of about 19,500 jobs, with around 41,800 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $45,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Coaches And Scouts, but it will reshape desk work. AI can edit video, calculate statistics, and draft scouting reports. People can then focus on in-game decisions, player motivation, and talent judgment. Sports are human competition: machines can calculate performance, but not morale or intent.
ai_s2_accel: AI tactical-analysis systems that identify formations and movement patterns
Player-potential models that inform recruitment and transfer decisions
Wearable devices that monitor training load and fatigue in real time
Video review and line-calling systems that assist officiating and analysis
ai_s2_auto: Automated game-video editing and tactical tagging
Automated tracking of player movement, touches, and other metrics
Generating scouting-report drafts and data templates
Digitizing training schedules and player-status records
ai_s3_list: In-game command: choose a substitution or tactical adjustment in a close contest.
Player motivation: understand mindset and lift morale.
Talent judgment: see potential, personality, and adaptability beyond the data.
Locker-room management: balance competition with team unity.
Training design and communication: explain tactics so players can execute them.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure tier. AI increasingly handles desk work such as video, data, and reports. Core value remains concentrated in training, in-game decisions, and talent management, where human experience matters most.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings major change. Data and video analysis are standard tools, and coaches or scouts who rely only on instinct face marginalization. People who use AI tools can spend more time on the most valuable work: developing and selecting players.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose a sport and build a relevant professional background before pursuing coaching or scouting. Gain experience through youth development and university teams. Treat data and video analysis as core skills rather than relying on enthusiasm alone.

Master video-analysis and data platforms, then build your own player database and tactical knowledge base. Coaches add value through results and data fluency, while scouts combine quantitative analysis with observation.

Career changers can enter sports through youth assistant coaching, data analysis, or scouting-assistant roles. Demonstrate ability through match analysis and player-evaluation work. Prove commitment with specific data and analysis rather than slogans.

Evaluate coaches through both team results and player-development cases. Evaluate scouts through identification accuracy rather than report volume. Set data-analysis skills as a firm requirement and create realistic mobility paths for grassroots coaches and scouts.

ai_s7_trends: Data and video analysis become standard for coaches and scouts, marginalizing experience-only approaches.
Growth in the sports industry and youth development creates more grassroots coaching and scouting roles.
AI potential models assist recruitment, but professionals who combine data, observation, and people skills remain scarcest.

body: Coaches And Scouts are sports professionals. Coaches create training plans, teach technical and tactical skills, and direct competition.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把一场比赛剪成十个战术片段，但「这个球员为什么心态崩了、怎么把他捞回来」，还得教练在更衣室里解决。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教练与球探在岗约 30.65 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.60 万人，净增约 1.95 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.59 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代教练和球探，但会重构案头工作：录像剪辑、数据统计、球探报告初稿都能交给 AI，人的时间转向临场指挥、球员激励和识人判断。体育是人的运动，机器算得出数据，算不出人心和士气。
ai_s2_accel: AI 战术分析系统自动识别阵型与跑位
球员潜力模型辅助选材与引援决策
可穿戴设备实时监测训练负荷与疲劳
视频裁判与鹰眼系统辅助判罚与复盘
ai_s2_auto: 比赛录像自动剪辑与战术标注
球员跑动、触球等数据自动统计
球探报告初稿与数据模板生成
训练日程与球员状态记录电子化
ai_s3_list: 临场指挥：比分胶着时的一个换人、一次调整。
球员激励：读懂心态，把士气提起来。
识人判断：数据之外的潜质、性格与可塑性。
更衣室管理：平衡竞争与团结的关系。
训练设计与沟通：把战术讲进球员脑子并落地。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的案头部分（录像、数据、报告）正被 AI 大幅接管，但核心价值集中在训练指导、临场指挥和识人用人这些「人的经验」上，AI 是工具，不是替代者。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：数据分析与视频分析已成为标配，「看不懂数据、只凭感觉」的教练和球探会被边缘化。会用 AI 工具的人，能把更多时间花在真正值钱的地方——带人、选人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走体育教练/球探路线，先选好运动专项并拿到专业背景，大学期间多参与青训、校队执教积累经验。把数据分析、视频分析作为必修技能，别只凭一腔热血。
把录像分析、数据平台用熟，建立自己的球员数据库和战术知识库。教练往「带成绩 + 懂数据」走，球探往「数据 + 眼力」复合走，都是增值方向。
转行进体育圈，先从青训助教、数据分析师、球探助理这些入口切入，用比赛分析和球员评估作品说话。展示你对项目的热爱要具体——用数据和分析证明，而不是口号。
选教练看带队成绩更看球员成长案例；选球探看识别精度而非报告数量。把数据分析能力作为硬门槛，同时给基层教练与球探更合理的流动通道。

ai_s7_trends: 数据与视频分析成为教练和球探的标配，纯经验流被边缘化。
体育产业与青训投入扩张，基层教练和球探岗位持续增加。
AI 潜力模型辅助选材，但「数据 + 眼力 + 带人」的复合人才最稀缺。

body: 教练与球探是体育行业的专业人才，教练负责制定训练计划、教授技战术并临场指挥比赛。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把一场比赛剪成十个战术片段，但「这个球员为什么心态崩了、怎么把他捞回来」，还得教练在更衣室里解决。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Models can calculate, but planners still decide how to survey the land, balance the restoration plan, and coordinate stakeholders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, about 90,300 Environmental Restoration Planners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 94,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,000 jobs, with about 8,500 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $80,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Environmental Restoration Planners, but it will greatly accelerate assessment and modeling. Remote sensing and ecological models speed up routine analysis, shifting human work from calculating data to field surveys, plan tradeoffs, stakeholder coordination, and long-term monitoring. Standardized assessment-only roles face the most pressure, while people who can design and coordinate become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: people must read the land.
Plan tradeoffs: people must strike the balance.
Stakeholder coordination: people must lead the communication.
Long-term monitoring: people must follow through.
Research design: people develop the ideas.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure. Systems greatly accelerate remote sensing and modeling, but field surveys and decisions still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces standardized assessment tasks, not the role that prescribes how land should recover. People who can design plans and coordinate stakeholders become scarcer as automation expands.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong foundations in ecology and GIS. Assessment-only work is shrinking, so start developing design and coordination skills early.
Move beyond assessment into planning, coordination, and monitoring, then seek responsibility for entire projects.
Emphasize project and field experience. Research institutes value practical depth and specialization.
Do not hire on academic credentials alone. Evaluate whether candidates can design plans, coordinate stakeholders, and develop viable projects. Give strong contributors the platform to lead.

ai_s7_trends: Remote-sensing models are becoming common, reducing routine assessment work.
Plan design and stakeholder coordination are receiving more attention.
Professionals with design skills are in greater demand.

body: Environmental Restoration Planners assess degraded ecosystems and contaminated sites. They design plans for vegetation recovery, soil and water restoration, and ecosystem reconstruction while balancing conservation with development.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Models can calculate, but planners still decide how to survey the land, balance the restoration plan, and coordinate stakeholders.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 建模能算，但地怎么踏、方案怎么权衡、各方怎么协调，还是规划师的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年环境修复规划师在岗约 9.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.43 万人，净增约 0.40 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会大幅加速评估与建模。遥感与生态建模把常规分析提速，人从「算数据」挪向「踏勘、方案权衡、多方协调、长期监测」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准评估的，会设计、能协调的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 踏勘判断：看地靠人。
方案权衡：平衡靠人。
多方协调：沟通靠人。
长期监测：跟进靠人。
科研设计：思路靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——遥感与建模被系统大幅加速，但踏勘与决策还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准评估」动作，不是「定复原处方」的岗位。会设计、能协调的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 打好生态与 GIS，纯评估在缩，早点练设计与协调。
从「评估」升级成「方案 + 协调 + 监测」，争取项目负责。
突出项目与野外经验，院所看重实和专。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会设计和协调，能立项目的骨干值得给平台。

ai_s7_trends: 遥感建模普及，评估缩。
方案协调更被看重。
会设计的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can draft the environmental baseline section of an impact assessment and run a pollution dispersion model overnight. But finding a hidden discharge pipe at a plant or tracing the odor reported by residents still requires field experience and legwork.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 90,300 Environmental Scientists And Specialists, Including Health were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 94,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,000 jobs, with about 8,500 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $80,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is reshaping environmental science work. It can process data, draft reports, and analyze models. Environmental scientists now create more value through field verification, solution judgment, and communication with agencies and companies, where AI is less capable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted remote sensing to identify pollution sources
Real-time monitoring with sensors and the Internet of Things
Automated creation of visual reports and presentations
ai_s2_auto: Automated cleaning and statistical analysis of monitoring data
Automated first drafts of environmental impact assessment reports
AI search across environmental standards and literature
ai_s3_list: Field verification: hidden pipes, illegal discharges, and odor sources require observation and legwork.
Solution judgment: data points to a direction, but a remediation plan must balance cost, feasibility, and public concerns.
Communication with agencies and companies: assessments need approval, corrective actions need implementation, and stakeholder demands must be reconciled.
Environmental commitment and public trust: signing a report means accepting responsibility for it. That is a professional baseline.
Cross-disciplinary synthesis: pollution connects industry, health, and policy, so scientists need a complete view.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure because data analysis, reporting, and modeling account for much of this work. These are tasks AI handles well. Professionals need to anchor their value in field verification, solution judgment, and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean the occupation will disappear, but it does require a different approach. AI will sharply reduce roles limited to report writing and model operation. Specialists who use AI to draft reports, then apply human field judgment and communication, can work faster and create more value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study environmental science or environmental engineering and build skills in data analysis, GIS, and programming. Do not train only for report writing in the AI era. Field sampling, solution judgment, and coordination form the real defense against automation.

Let AI prepare the first report draft while you verify it and handle fieldwork. Pursue credentials such as Environmental Impact Assessment Engineer and progress toward project-lead or technical-specialist roles. Upgrade quickly if your work is limited to report execution.

A background in environmental work or data analysis provides an advantage when changing careers. Start as an environmental impact assessment technician or monitoring analyst. Resume evidence such as leading an assessment project or discovering an environmental problem is more useful than a list of software names.

Do not evaluate environmental specialists only by report volume. Everyone can access AI tools, so test field-verification reasoning and communication skills. Equip people with AI for report work, freeing them to inspect sites and make judgments that improve project quality.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Online water and air quality monitoring
Find pollution sources in satellite imagery
First draft of an environmental impact assessment report
Collect water, air, and soil samples

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over data analysis and first report drafts, shifting environmental professionals toward field verification and solution judgment.
Stricter carbon and environmental regulations increase demand for multidisciplinary specialists who understand policy and communicate well.
Remote sensing and Internet of Things monitoring broaden data sources, making professional judgment more important.

body: Environmental Scientists And Specialists, Including Health use monitoring, experiments, and models to study the causes, effects, and prevention of environmental pollution. They assess environmental quality and health risks and prepare environmental impact assessment reports.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一晚上写完环评报告的现状章节、跑完污染扩散模型，但那个厂区的暗管到底在哪、村民说的那股异味来自哪里，还得靠你的现场经验和脚步。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年专家科学家在岗约 9.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.43 万人，净增约 0.40 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在深度改变环境科学工作——数据处理、报告初稿、模型分析都能交给 AI。环境科学家的价值转向现场核查、方案判断、部门与企业沟通这些 AI 不擅长的部分。
ai_s2_accel: 传感器物联网实时监测
AI 辅助健康风险评估
可视化报告与演示自动生成
ai_s2_auto: 监测数据自动清洗与统计
环评报告初稿自动生成
污染扩散模型自动跑算
环境标准与文献 AI 检索
ai_s3_list: 现场核查：暗管、偷排、异味源，靠脚步和眼力去找。
方案判断：数据给方向，但治理方案要权衡成本、可行与民意。
与政府企业沟通：环评要过审、整改要落地，各方诉求要揉动。
环保情怀与公信：报告签了字就要负责，是职业底线。
跨学科综合：污染问题连着工业、健康、政策，要看得全。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的数据分析、报告、建模比重很高，这正是 AI 最擅长替代的部分——必须把价值锚定在现场核查、方案判断与沟通协调上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于岗位消失，但意味着「换打法」——只会写报告、跑模型的技术员会被 AI 大幅压缩。能驾驭 AI 出报告、再靠人做现场判断与沟通的专家，效率更高、价值更大。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选环境科学或工程专业，把数据分析、GIS 和编程学起来。AI 时代别只学「写报告」，现场采样、方案判断、沟通协调是环境工作者真正的护城河。
让 AI 出报告初稿、你负责把关与现场。考环评工程师等证书，往项目负责人、技术专家方向走；纯报告执行岗要尽快升级。
有环境或数据分析背景转行有优势，从环评技术员或监测分析员切入。简历写「主导过XX环评项目、发现过XX环境问题」这类成果，比罗列软件名有用。
招环境专家别只看报告产量，AI 工具大家都有，要考现场核查思路与沟通能力。给人配 AI 工具，把人从写报告里解放出来做现场与判断，项目质量会提升。

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管数据分析与报告初稿，环境工作者重心转向现场核查与方案判断。
双碳与环保监管趋严，懂政策、能沟通的复合专家更抢手。
遥感与物联网监测普及，数据来源更广，专业判断价值凸显。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI cameras can recognize signs of drowning, but lifeguards still decide what is actually happening in the water and whether to enter for a rescue.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 149,700 recreational protective service workers employed in 2024, projected to reach 158,400 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 8,700 jobs, with roughly 42,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $33,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace lifeguards, but it will assist them. Drowning detection and smart monitoring help lifeguards cover larger areas and identify abnormalities faster, while people must still enter the water, deliver first aid, and judge whether someone is in danger. The occupation centers on responsibility and action; AI can serve as eyes, but not hands and legs.
ai_s3_list: Hazard anticipation: recognize when movement or condition looks wrong.
Rescue ability: enter quickly, tow securely, and deliver accurate first aid.
Concentration: monitor water for eight hours without drifting.
Composure: remain calm during emergencies.
Safety communication: make rules meaningful to visitors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score reflects limited technical replacement. Cameras and AI can assist observation, but entering the water, performing rescue, and making on-site judgments are physical actions AI cannot replace. The 4-point score also warns that cameras assist lifeguards but cannot own safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Treat AI as a third eye. Use smart monitoring to support surveillance, then invest saved attention in stronger rescue skills. Certified lifeguards with first-aid ability and strong fitness remain scarce in every setting.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Lifeguarding works well as a vacation job and source of social experience; certification can enable summer work. Remember that it is a responsibility role, not a watching-water role. People who love it can move toward aquatic coaching or swim education.

Develop professionally by earning advanced credentials for deep water, surf, and still water, then move toward aquatic safety management or coaching. Improve first aid and AED operation, portable skills valued everywhere.

For strong swimmers seeking an accessible transition job, lifeguarding is a good option. Emphasize swimming ability and first-aid credentials in interviews; prior rescue experience is preferred. Seasonal peaks provide entry opportunities.

Lifeguard turnover is high. Retention depends on certification pay, fair schedules, and advancement paths. Developing strong lifeguards into coaches or safety supervisors is more reliable than seasonal last-minute recruitment.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Full video coverage of aquatic areas
Life rings, rescue boards, and throw lines
Alerts for abnormal swimmer vital signs

ai_s7_trends: AI drowning detection and smart monitoring become standard at large venues.
Lifeguards advance toward certified professional rescue and first-aid roles.
Aquatic sports and swim education create transition opportunities.

body: Lifeguards and recreational protective service workers monitor safety at pools, beaches, water parks, ski areas, and other recreational settings. They prevent hazards, perform rescues, deliver first aid, and provide safety education.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 摄像头能识别溺水动作，但「这片水里的那个人到底怎么了、要不要跳下去」——这种判断和救援，还是得救生员来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年保护服务工人在岗约 14.97 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.84 万人，净增约 0.87 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代救生员，但会成为辅助：AI 溺水识别、智能监控正在帮助救生员盯更多区域、更快发现异常；但最终的下水救援、急救处置、对「人到底有没有事」的判断，必须由真人完成。这个岗位的核心是「责任和行动」，AI 只能当眼睛，当不了手和腿。
ai_s2_accel: 智能手环监测泳客异常
AED 与急救设备智能化
人流预警与风险提示系统
ai_s2_auto: 监控摄像头覆盖与录像回放
AI 溺水动作识别预警
排班与上岗记录电子化
ai_s3_list: 危险预判：从动作和状态里看出不对劲。
救援能力：下水快、拖带稳、急救准。
专注力：八小时盯水不走神。
心理素质：出事时冷静不慌。
沟通宣传：把安全规则讲进人心里。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个岗位的技术替代面有限：监控和 AI 能辅助「看」，但「下水救、上手救、现场判断」全是物理世界的行动，AI 替代不了；4 分也提醒你，摄像头会帮你，但别把安全完全交给机器。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 AI 当「第三只眼」：用智能监控辅助盯防，把省下的精力放在提升救援技能上；持证、会急救、体能好的救生员，在任何场所都是稀缺资源。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 救生员适合假期兼职和积累社会经验，考个证暑期就能上岗；但提醒孩子这是「责任岗」不是「看水岗」，别拿生命开玩笑。如果热爱，可以往水上运动教练、游泳教育方向发展。
往专业方向走：考深水、海浪、静水等高级证书，转水上安全管理员或教练；同时提升急救和 AED 操作能力，这些证书走到哪都吃香。
水性好、想找个门槛不高的岗位过渡，救生员很合适；面试时突出游泳水平和急救证书，有救生经验的优先；旺季岗位多，可以先做季节工积累。
救生员流失快，留人靠「持证补贴+排班公平+转岗通道」；把优秀救生员培养成教练或安全主管，比旺季前临时招人靠谱得多。

ai_s7_trends: AI 溺水识别与智能监控成为大型场馆标配。
救生员向持证专业救援与急救人才升级。
水上运动与游泳教育需求带动救生员转岗。

body: 救生员与休闲保护服务人员负责泳池、海滨、水上乐园、滑雪场等休闲场所的安全监护，预防危险、实施救援、进行急救处置并开展安全宣传。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Motorboat Mechanics And Service Technicians, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 26,200 motorboat mechanics and service technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 27,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,600 jobs, with roughly 2,600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $55,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace motorboat mechanics and service technicians, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creative problem-solving. Routine execution that follows instructions mechanically will lose ground, while technicians who understand real-world conditions and make sound decisions will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate customer or learner assessment in motorboat service work.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate repair-plan testing for motorboat service work.
Use retrieval tools to verify technical information and regulations for motorboat service work.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in motorboat service work.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for motorboat mechanics and service technicians.
Process and classify repetitive data for motorboat mechanics and service technicians.
Perform rules-based initial screening and scheduling for motorboat mechanic and service work.
Search motorboat service knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real-world motorboat service settings.
The ability to explain motorboat service expertise to non-specialists.

跨域协同：衔接靠人。

Specialty processes: expertise remains human.

Reviewing proofs with clients: communication remains human.

Do not hire based only on physical strength; assess troubleshooting ability. Press leads who can manage shifts deserve higher skilled rates.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assemble decades of title history in minutes, but a title examiner still decides whether a record could derail the transfer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 57,400 title examiners, abstractors, and searchers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 58,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,100 jobs, with about 5,400 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $55,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace title examiners, but it will replace much pure searching and abstract preparation. Electronic registries combined with AI search complete in minutes what once took days, shifting examiners from retrieving files toward cross-validation, defect assessment, and risk disclosure. Expertise in rules and judgment under uncertainty are the truly scarce capabilities.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted identification of anomalies and missing records
Knowledge bases and automatic adaptation for multi-state registration rules
Intelligent aggregation and prescreening of transaction due-diligence materials
ai_s2_auto: Electronic searches and index matching for title records
Automatic title-chain assembly and first-draft abstracts
Automated verification of tax, lien, and other public records
ai_s3_list: Defect assessment: Understanding the rules is essential to determine whether a record creates a problem or affects title.
Cross-validation: Experience and judgment determine which source is more credible when electronic records conflict with originals.
Multi-source integration: AI can miss connections when combining deeds, judgments, liens, and tax records into a complete picture.
Accountability and compliance: Reports require signatures and responsibility. AI can supply materials but cannot bear liability.
Communication with transaction parties: Clearly explaining risks and proposing workable solutions creates additional value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 reflects an occupation centered on information processing. Searching, comparison, and abstract preparation are exactly where AI excels, leaving substantial room for automation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: The key to low-to-moderate risk lies in examination. The further work moves downstream, the more it requires judgment and accountability. Pure search and abstract roles will shrink, while examiners who reach conclusions and accept responsibility will remain more secure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Legal, accounting, and real estate programs all provide entry routes, but develop strong data-analysis, information-retrieval, and legal-document reading skills. Many people can read records; far fewer can judge them.

Adopt AI search and reporting tools proactively and devote the saved time to multi-state rules and complex cases. Title insurance review and law-firm due diligence offer much broader pathways than pure searching.

Starting as a title-company clerk or searcher is the most practical route. Learn registration systems and state rules before advancing into examination and review. Relevant certifications, such as title insurance credentials, provide a clear advantage.

Do not hire examiners based only on search speed. Assess whether they independently produce reports and identify real risks. People who provide judgment when AI searches fall short are more valuable than those who rely on speed alone.

Digitization and search of historical records

ai_s7_trends: Paper registrations are digitizing rapidly, AI search drives retrieval costs toward zero, and pure search roles continue to shrink.
Title examination is concentrating on judgment and accountability, making multi-state rule expertise a professional moat.
Real estate transaction workflows are becoming fully digital, with automatically generated title reports and due-diligence materials becoming standard.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年产权审查、摘要与检索员在岗约 5.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.85 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.54 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.50 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代产权审查员，但会大量替代纯检索和摘要整理。电子登记库加上 AI 检索，几分钟就能完成过去几天的查档，审查员的时间从「翻档案」挪向「交叉验证、瑕疵判断和风险提示」。真正稀缺的，是对规则的掌握和对不确定性的判断。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助识别异常与缺失记录
多州登记规则的知识库化与自动适配
产权报告的模板化自动生成
交易尽调资料的智能聚合与预筛
ai_s2_auto: 产权档案的电子化检索与索引匹配
产权链条的自动串联与摘要初稿生成
重复性记录比对的机器完成
税费、抵押等公开记录的自动核验
ai_s3_list: 瑕疵判断：一条记录算不算问题、会不会影响产权，需要人对规则的理解。
交叉验证：电子记录和原始档案冲突时，谁更可信，要靠经验和判断。
多源信息整合：房契、判决、抵押、税单拼成完整图景，AI 容易顾此失彼。
责任与合规意识：报告要签字、要担责，AI 只能给材料不能担责任。
与交易方的沟通：把风险讲清楚、给出可行的处理方案，是审查员的增值点。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业以信息处理为主——检索、比对、整理摘要，这些正是 AI 最擅长的领域，自动化空间确实很大。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低-中风险的关键在「审查」二字：越往下游走，越需要判断和担责。纯做检索摘要的岗位会被压缩，能出结论、能扛责任的审查员反而更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 法律、会计或房地产相关专业都可以，但要把数据分析、信息检索和法律文书阅读练扎实。会「读档」的人很多，会「判档」的人不多。
主动把 AI 检索和报告工具用起来，把时间投向多州规则学习和复杂案例。往产权保险审核、律所尽调方向走，路径比单纯做检索宽得多。
从产权公司文员或检索岗切入最实际，先熟悉登记系统和州内规则，再往审查和审核岗爬。考取相关认证（如产权保险相关证书）能明显加分。
招审查员别只看检索速度，要看能不能独立出报告、识别真风险。能给 AI 检索做兜底判断的人，比单纯的手速型选手更值得留。
